title: What I built for myself, a job seeker
headSub: One personal tool, grouped by the journey: everything from finding a job to a resume I would actually send. The one thing it does not do is decide for me.

cards.label: FIND
lines: Sources: Adzuna, Greenhouse, Lever, custom URLs
Filters: experience, posting age, dead links

cards.label: MATCH
lines: Fit scored across three career tracks
Matches home base, ranked best-fit first

cards.label: UNDERSTAND
cards.sub: go deep on the strong ones
lines: Deep review on the strong matches

cards.label: TAILOR
lines: Export: md, pdf, docx, html, txt, json

takeaway.text: Everything from a raw job posting to a resume I would send. It stops at the apply button on purpose. {{blue:The decision to apply is mine.}}
